'''Anne-Marie Caminade''' is a French chemist who is Director of Research Exceptional Class at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]]. Her research considers dendrimers and heterochemistry. She was awarded the 2021 [[Société chimique de France]] Achille le Bel Grand Prize.

== Early life and education ==
Caminade was a doctoral researcher at [[Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier University]]. She investigated the oxidation of unsaturated bonds, including the carbon – carbon double bond (C = C), C = P and P = P.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Etude comparative de l'oxydation de liaisons insaturées C=C, P=C, P=P|publisher=[s.n.]|date=1984|place=S.l.|language=French|first=Anne-Marie|last=Caminade|oclc=490851089 }}</ref> Her research considered the stabilisation of low coordinate phosphorus.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=STABILISATION PAR COMPLEXATION D'ENTITES PHOSPHOREES DE BASSE COORDINENCE|date=1988|language=French|first=Anne-Marie|last=Caminade|oclc=1164075322 }}</ref> She moved to [[Saarland University]] as a postdoctoral fellow in the laboratory of [[:de:Michael Veith (Chemiker)|Michael Veith]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=*{{!}}MC:SUBJECT{{!}}*|url=https://new.societechimiquedefrance.fr/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/SCFinfo_mi-juillet2021-1.html|access-date=2021-07-15|website=new.societechimiquedefrance.fr}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
Caminade's research involves the chemistry of [[phosphorus]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=The phosphorus dendrimers by Dr Anne-Marie Caminade {{!}} UEMF|url=https://ueuromed.org/en/news/cycle-conferences/phosphorus-dendrimers-dr-anne-marie-caminade|access-date=2021-07-15|website=ueuromed.org}}</ref> In particular, she is interested in hydrides, macrocells, cryptants and hyperbranched polymers. She has shown that the biological properties of dendrimers are influenced by their internal structures. By incorporating phosphorus into functionalised dendrimers (where phosphorus atoms are included at every branching point) and manipulating the internal structure, Caminade has shown them to be useful for anti-inflammatory medications and anti-cancer treatments.{{cn|date=July 2021}}

In 2006 Caminade was appointed leader of the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] “Molecular and supramolecular heterochemistry” team.<ref name=":0" />

== Awards and honours ==
* 1988 [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] Fellow{{cn|date=July 2021}}
* 1989 [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] Bronze medal<ref>{{Cite web|title=Talents {{!}} CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/en/talents/cnrs?medal=40|access-date=2021-07-15|website=www.cnrs.fr|language=en}}</ref> 
* 2006 [[Société chimique de France]] Organic Chemistry Award<ref>{{Cite web|title=Archives des Chimie organique|url=https://new.societechimiquedefrance.fr/distinctions_cat/chimie-organique/|access-date=2021-07-15|website=Société Chimique de France|language=fr-FR}}</ref>
* 2011 Appointed to the advisory board of the [[Chemical Society Reviews]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chemical Society Reviews journal|url=https://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/chem-soc-rev/|access-date=2021-07-15|website=Royal Society of Chemistry|language=en-GB}}</ref>
* 2021 [[Société chimique de France]] Achille le Bel Grand Prize<ref name=":0" />

Caminade was awarded the [[Société chimique de France]] Achille le Bel Grand Prize for her contributions to dendrimers and the application of dendrimers in catalysis.<ref name=":0" />
